sentence: The NHS describes metformin as a medicine used to treat type 2 diabetes, and says it is usually the first choice prescribed for it.

sentence: The NHS says metformin comes as two kinds of tablet: standard tablets and slow-release tablets.

sentence: Standard tablets act quickly and may be taken several times a day, while slow-release ones work gradually, so they are taken less often.
